oracle_note: One click, pinned. The default oracle takes the interior peak of the reference alpha, and here that lands on the NOTEPAD the subject is holding. SAM 2 then correctly returns the notepad (1.3% of frame) against a whole-person reference (17.2%), scoring MAD 157 / boundary-F 0.000 for a reason that is about subject ambiguity, not matte quality: the green-screen key counted the held object as foreground, a click cannot know that. The click is moved to her torso and written down here. Identical for every method.
